notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{G}.
description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{U}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{G}.
Repeat.
